import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

def ols(y, X):                    # 절편 포함 최소제곱 → (계수, 표준오차, p, R²)
    y = np.asarray(y, float)
    X1 = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(y))] + [np.asarray(x, float) for x in X])
    b, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X1, y, rcond=None)
    resid = y - X1 @ b
    n, k = X1.shape
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(resid @ resid / (n - k) * np.linalg.inv(X1.T @ X1)))
    p = 2 * stats.t.sf(np.abs(b / se), n - k)
    r2 = 1 - (resid @ resid) / ((y - y.mean()) @ (y - y.mean()))
    return b, se, p, r2

svy = load("svy")
b, se, p, r2 = ols(svy.mil, [svy.hjs])
print(round(b[0], 2), round(b[1], 2), round(r2, 2))
# -0.01 0.98 0.4

b, se, p, r2 = ols(svy.mil, [svy.hjs])
print(round(se[1], 3), round(b[1] / se[1], 1),
      [float(round(b[1] - 1.96 * se[1], 2)), float(round(b[1] + 1.96 * se[1], 2))])
# 0.051 19.2 [0.88, 1.08]

x, y = svy.hjs.values, svy.mil.values         # 이 묶음 내내 쓰는 두 변수
resid = y - (b[0] + b[1] * x)
ss_res = resid @ resid
ss_tot = (y - y.mean()) @ (y - y.mean())
print(round(1 - ss_res / ss_tot, 4), round(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1] ** 2, 4))
# 0.3953 0.3953

pred = b[0] + b[1] * x
print(round(resid.mean(), 6) + 0.0,            # + 0.0 = 아주 작은 계산 오차로 찍히는 -0.0 을 0.0 으로
      round(np.corrcoef(pred, resid)[0, 1], 6) + 0.0)
# 0.0 0.0

i = np.argmax(np.abs(x - x.mean()))           # 평균에서 가장 먼 점
keep = np.ones(len(x), bool); keep[i] = False
print(round(x[i], 2), round(b[1], 4),
      round(np.polyfit(x[keep], y[keep], 1)[0], 4))
# 2.33 0.9782 0.9724

print(round(b[0] + b[1] * 6, 2),
      round(b[0] + b[1] * 6 - resid.std(ddof=1), 2),
      round(b[0] + b[1] * 6 + resid.std(ddof=1), 2))
# 5.86 4.89 6.83

exp = load("exp")                               # 실험판 366명 (3장)
bc, sec, pc, _ = ols(exp.mil, [exp.cond])
print(round(bc[0], 2), round(bc[1], 3), round(pc[1], 3))
# 4.98 0.283 0.028

zx = (x - x.mean()) / x.std(ddof=1)
zy = (y - y.mean()) / y.std(ddof=1)
bz, *_ = ols(zy, [zx])
print(round(bz[1], 4), round(np.corrcoef(x, y)[0, 1], 4))
# 0.6288 0.6288
